result.summary: Optimizes JSON serialization of partial signatures in `decodepsbt` by replacing duplicate-checking insertions with `pushKVEnd`. Because the internal PSBT structure already indexes partial signatures by unique public key ID, duplicate checking across inputs is redundant.
result.problem: Constructing JSON partial signature maps in `decodepsbt` incurs an O(N^2) scan as each new entry searches all previously added keys in the JSON object, degrading performance on transactions with many signatures.
evidence: Commit 5ef0b448c9: 'The PSBT parser stores each partial signature by the ID of its public key, so the hex-encoded public keys are already distinct. Use pushKVEnd to append each entry without scanning the keys already added.'
result.scope_notes: Very small change (+13/-2 across 2 files) consisting of an RPC serialization tweak and a test vector check.
result.card: This PR optimizes partial signature serialization in `decodepsbt` by replacing quadratic duplicate checks with direct appends (`pushKVEnd`). It addresses unnecessary O(N^2) JSON key scans when decoding PSBTs containing many partial signatures. Because PSBT inputs store partial signatures by public key ID, duplicate key checks are redundant.

risk.why: A mistake in JSON construction could produce malformed JSON or duplicate keys in the `decodepsbt` RPC output.
